hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); if ! out=$("$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/ops/guard-worktree-pnpm.sh "$cwd" "$cmd"); then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ "$d" != "." ] && [ ! -f "$d/.prettierignore" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/.prettierignore" ]; then pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown --ignore-path "$d/.gitignore" --ignore-path "$d/.prettierignore" "$f"; else pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; fi; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
